result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but a few elements appear clipped or visually incomplete near the viewport edges and bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, cutting off its content and making the card appear unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content, or ensure the navigation overlays only an empty safe area so the full card can be viewed.

issues.description: The circular element in the top-right header contains only a red dot and otherwise appears empty, making it look like a missing icon or broken profile/notification control.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon or avatar inside the circle, or remove the container if it is not meant to be displayed.

issues.description: The category carousel and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partial category pill and truncated restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intentional, provide a clearer carousel affordance and ensure clipping looks deliberate; otherwise constrain or wrap the content within the viewport.
